messages:
Sarah G: FYI ACME legal is asking for interim assurance docs + an NDA before we can share any SOC-type materials. They want something this week if possible.
Mike (Legal): We can provide a signed bridge letter and a redacted extract under NDA. Need to confirm exact scope they want and any retention/redistribution limits.
Jordan - Security: We can do a redacted Type 2 extract + high-level control narrative. For interim/extracts we scrub internal IPs, account names, and any customer identifiers.
Elaine (CSM): They also asked for KMS/crypto details and confirmation that no prod data leaves EU regions. ACME is UK-based, so residency matters.
Sarah G: @Mike (Legal) do we have a bridge-letter template we can push quickly? Also what's the NDA cadence (standard mutual NDA ok?)
Mike (Legal): Use internal template: https://redwood.internal/legal/bridge_letter_v2.docx. Standard mutual NDA is fine; expedite via DocuSign. I can sign the bridge letter once we confirm limits.
Jordan - Security: Timeline note: full SOC 2 Type 2 final report is expected mid-May, but we can produce a redacted interim extract + one-page security summary today/tomorrow. Will remove: internal hostnames, IP ranges, employee IDs.
Elaine (CSM): Perfect. ACME also wants a short controls mapping to SIG/CAIQ sections for their vendor risk team.
Sarah G: @Jordan - can you include a one-page SIG/CAIQ highlight? If we can get that + NDA + bridge letter signed, I'll open POC infra access (timeboxed) for them.
Jordan - Security: Yep. I'll assemble a 1-pager and a minimal control mapping. Sample snippet we'll include:
```
Shared controls: access controls (IAM), encryption at rest (KMS), network isolation (VPC)
Redactions applied: internal IP ranges, internal monitoring endpoints, employee lists
Delivery: PDF under NDA via secure link
```
Mike (Legal): Redaction checklist is fine. Confirmed acceptable terms: no redistribution, review-only, 90-day bridge letter validity (can discuss longer if needed).
deploy-bot: doc-sent: bridge_letter_v2 -> acme-legal@acme.com via docusign
Sarah G: Nice. I'll request the NDA signature and note the 90-day limit to their legal. After signed, I'll trigger POC credentials (read-only, limited token scope).
Jordan - Security: I'll post the 1-pager in this thread once ready and a secure link for the redacted extract.
Elaine (CSM): I'll update the ACME onboarding checklist and prep the brief for the customer call tomorrow.
Sarah G: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone—looping in AE (Tom) on the next steps.
